hints.en: Text comparison: `"moderator" < "admin"` is `False` but `"admin" < "user"` is `True`; the order is meaningless.

hints.tr: `RANK[user_role] < RANK[required_role]`; sonra yatay koşulu: `owner is not None and owner != user and user_role == "user"`.
hints.en: `RANK[user_role] < RANK[required_role]`; then the horizontal condition: `owner is not None and owner != user and user_role == "user"`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
RANK = {"user": 1, "moderator": 2, "admin": 3}


def classify_attempt(user, user_role, owner, required_role):
    if RANK[user_role] < RANK[required_role]:
        return "vertical"
    if owner is not None and owner != user and user_role == "user":
        return "horizontal"
    return "allowed"

print(classify_attempt("ada", "user", "ada", "user"))
print(classify_attempt("ada", "user", "alan", "user"))
print(classify_attempt("ada", "user", None, "admin"))
print(classify_attempt("grace", "moderator", "alan", "moderator"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
RANK = {"user": 1, "moderator": 2, "admin": 3}


def classify_attempt(user, user_role, owner, required_role):
    if RANK[user_role] < RANK[required_role]:
        return "vertical"
    if owner is not None and owner != user and user_role == "user":
        return "horizontal"
    return "allowed"

print(classify_attempt("ada", "user", "ada", "user"))
print(classify_attempt("ada", "user", "alan", "user"))
print(classify_attempt("ada", "user", None, "admin"))
print(classify_attempt("grace", "moderator", "alan", "moderator"))
```
